name: USB Hub Support
author: NachoCasta
summary: Experimental candidate for USB hub support with PRO DJ LINK.
description: Experimental candidate awaiting final validation. Tests hub libraries with four local decks when Link is off, or two local decks with external players when on. Hub libraries stay local. Short-press USB STOP to select a stick; hold to eject the hub. Wait for safe-to-remove confirmation. Loaded tracks use a limited native cache. Exact firmware 2.00 only. Audio-phase sync, real-CDJ and eight-source hardware use remain unvalidated. The framework stages files internally. USB-removal/full-restart recovery remains unverified.
